visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short brown hair, wearing glasses and a sleeveless white top, sits on a beige sofa and speaks directly to the camera. Large white captions appear centrally. (2) She points her finger while speaking. The scene cuts to B-roll of a woman with blonde hair dancing in a bright living room. (3) Cut to B-roll of a young woman in a denim jacket eating a salad in a restaurant setting. The main speaker returns, gesturing toward her stomach. (4) Close-up shot of a bowl of healthy food containing purple cabbage, mushrooms, and grains. The speaker continues her explanation from the sofa. (5) She points two fingers. The scene cuts to B-roll of a woman in a pink blazer sitting at a desk with a laptop, looking extremely stressed and screaming while pulling her hair. (6) A round inset clip appears showing the main speaker laughing boisterously. She then returns to the main frame, gesturing with her hands. (7) She points three fingers. The scene cuts to B-roll of a woman in bed wearing a purple sleep mask, waking up. (8) B-roll of a person's hand holding a smartphone in a dark room. The speaker gives a final warning gesture. (9) A final static screen appears with a white background, featuring a dark logo, contact numbers, and social media handles for a dermatology clinic.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, bright medical clinic interior with a beige sofa, contrasted with various B-roll scenes: a living room with white shelves, a restaurant interior, an office with glass partitions, and a dark bedroom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy female voice speaks rapidly over an upbeat pop BGM with a strong electronic beat. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX signals a transition to the first health tip. (3) A percussive 'ding' SFX emphasizes the mention of gut microbes. (4) A loud, high-pitched vocal scream SFX occurs when the topic of stress is introduced. (5) A bubbly laughing sound effect follows the meme-style laughing visual. (6) The vocal narration continues with high arousal, detailing sleep habits, accompanied by a subtle transition SFX. (7) The BGM volume swells as the voice track ends, and the electronic music fades out sharply with a final percussive hit.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Warning -> Tip 1 -> Tip 2 -> Tip 3 -> Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on three non-obvious factors—poor gut health, excessive stress, and irregular sleep—that accelerate aging. It combines expert medical advice with engaging social-media style editing and B-roll to promote a dermatology clinic's professional expertise.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features the clinic's logo throughout and ends with a complete business information screen for DRX Dermatology Clinic.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly produced professional health tip video using fast-paced editing and social-media-friendly SFX to maintain viewer engagement while building authority for a clinic.
